summary: Constructor/initializer for a 40-byte float-bearing structure. Zeroes the first seven dword fields, sets the last three dword fields to 1.0f (giving the trailing component an identity-like value), then calls Identity44MatrixInit to initialize an embedded 4x4 matrix, and returns the object. Called from seven sites including matrix/vertex transform helpers.

operations.description: Zero the first four dword fields at offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8 and 0xC.
Zero the next three dword fields at offsets 0x10, 0x14 and 0x18.
Set the final three dword fields at offsets 0x1C, 0x20 and 0x24 to 1.0f.
Call Identity44MatrixInit() to initialize the embedded 4x4 matrix portion of the object.
